{{Top|leg}}
A '''penglow''' was a tool that could emit a beam light to allow its user to see more clearly in a darker area. [[Zakarisz Ghent]] used a penglow to inspect inside of [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] casing while solving programming glitches the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was experiencing.<ref name="DN III">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>
